title: Entity status heading
guidance: All entity lifecycle/status badges anchor at the upper right, matching the human-selected Pending example. Use intrinsic flow; enlarged/narrow layouts keep the badge at the right without squeezing the heading. Attachment tags and checklist icons retain their different meaning.
Repeated Accepted inconsistency is a defect: canonical lifecycle label/tone/icon must be shared across workbench and every story. Generic informational badges must not stand in for Accepted.

Human rejects the purple/violet color direction. Remove it from tonal task actions and progress badges; replacement colors remain pending human judgment. Preserve previous evidence as rejected/superseded, never accepted.

decisions.title: Lifecycle state anchors at the upper right
decisions.reason: Use the shared intrinsic heading grid. Status precedes the full-width identity row only when enlarged narrow text needs it; no absolute coordinates or truncated labels.

decisions.title: Status roles remain distinct
decisions.reason: Job lifecycle and review verification occupy their heading slot; attachment types and checklist outcomes retain their local semantic position. Pending uses a clock.

parameters.name: Heading grid
parameters.description: minmax(0,1fr) + auto columns; start alignment; 1rem column and .75rem row gaps. At max30rem and enlarged text, the badge occupies a right-aligned first row.

parameters.name: Canonical lifecycle identity
parameters.description: lifecycleDefinitions owns exact label/tone/icon; lifecycleBadge is the only host lifecycle renderer. Accepted person-check/info, In Progress clock/progress, Completed sealed-check/success, Cancelled close/neutral.

status.human: manual guidance received; revision awaits human review
status.color: Purple rejected. Replacement slate-blue/blue-teal palette awaiting human judgment

exportNote: Decision-only extract. Rendered evidence and review history are excluded from this handoff. Human-unvisited states remain unvisited; no new visual acceptance is claimed.
